description:
PROVEN on spike wt-spike-k22b (2026-07-09), +127 LoC across 2 demand files, lib 1278/0/6 zero warnings, full matrix exactly the 10 known-red (nothing new red). Distinct bug from fz-k22.7 (which is the capture-lane surface, bug 2).

ROOT: reachable_clauses is a legitimate TYPE-LEVEL under-approximation -- the [] base clause of reduce_while_cont (FunctionId 203) genuinely looks dead once the recursive list slot converges to non-empty [int]. But codegen lower_symbolic_body UNCONDITIONALLY lowers every structural clause; it never consults reachable_clauses. So the demand/liveness passes and codegen disagree on which clauses exist -> native env_runtime_var (native.rs:3127) finds the base-case accumulator ValueId(6) Absent -> crash. NOT a list-family convergence bug (is_pure_list_family is correct); NOT the fix-a demand-seam capture work (phase-ordering dead-end).

FIX (correct locus = demand<->codegen contract; codegen is ground truth for what gets lowered, so demand must widen to match, never lead): transport.rs (~+70) split return_sources off reachable_clauses to also walk the delta of codegen-lowered clauses the type analysis excluded, GATED to bare LoweredTail::Value clauses with no steps; added collect_all_entries_from unconditional structural entry walk for those; made local_clause_ids/local_entry_ids pub(super). runtime_demand.rs (~+25) derive_executable_runtime_demand live-demand loop walks the same widened set. The trivial-clause gate (steps.is_empty() and LoweredTail::Value) is LOAD-BEARING: such a clause can only add value-liveness, never resurrect a pruned call/continuation-capture shape -- proven by a masked-regression guard: a blanket walk broke compiler2_transport_plan_preserves_enumerable_suspend_continuation_captures (3 captures -> 0); the gate makes it safe.

Does NOT green enum_predicate_search alone -- exposes bug 2 (fz-k22.7). Production cleanup before landing: REMOVE all fz-k22 spike comment tags from code (no ticket IDs in code per standing rule); add a telemetry/fixture regression test pinning base-case clause-0 accumulator stays demanded; consider folding the two near-identical delta-widening loops into one shared helper with a single trivial-clause predicate.
title: fz-k22: demand passes over-prune clause-0 base-case accumulator vs codegen which lowers all clauses -- native materializes an Absent value
